scientific_question: Can the first predeclared compact capacity that preserves all five fit-only LOTO compatibility rows retain the exact dual-lift/K1 mechanism while reducing observation-only proposal cost enough to address the v11.3 wall and RSS failures?

full_fit_model.loss: inherit the v11.3 downstream teacher-deficiency plus 0.1 certificate loss without truth access
full_fit_model.checkpoint_rule: exactly epoch 120; one seed; no early stopping, ranking, ensemble, or result-dependent retraining

post_open_resource_profile.candidate_path: G_theta(y) -> exact A^T -> observable alpha in [0,2] -> unchanged CGLS K1
post_open_resource_profile.arm_order: alternate the leading arm by repetition index
post_open_resource_profile.wall_gate: candidate outer-process median at least 10 percent below reference
post_open_resource_profile.RSS_gate: candidate whole-worker peak RSS p90 no more than 1.05 times reference
post_open_resource_profile.accuracy_gate: unchanged v11.3 per-frame compatibility and harm rules, reported only as post-open development evidence
post_open_resource_profile.failure_action: record the failed resource or compatibility gate; do not enlarge the model or reinterpret p45-s03 as fresh
